answer: Each agent gets a cardiac rhythm anchor, a heartbeat print off a wrist wearable. First, the agent records ECG traces for 14 days, and the network keeps its R-R intervals and waveform. Second, random rechecks demand a fresh 60 second trace in 10 minutes. Third, a miss burns its 250 POA bond and freezes it for 30 days. A fake needs a 180 dollar watch, so 1,000 fakes cost 180,000 dollars, and the bill only spirals. With no real pulse, an attacker stands on a narrow ledge, one slip from losing it all, while each heartbeat plays its own rhythm, like ivory piano keys, each worn in its own spot.
